question.prompt: The graph of the linear function \(y=kx+b\) is parallel to the line \(y=2x-1\) and passes through \((1,5)\). Find the value of \(b\).

solutions.explanation: The two lines are parallel, so their values of \(k\) are equal. Thus, \(k=2\). Substituting \((1,5)\) gives \(2+b=5\), so \(b=3\).
solutions.title: Parallel lines and substitution
